newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Polytama Intl US$200 mln notes B-plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Polytama Intl US$200 mln notes B-plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it assigned a B-plus long-term rating to the US$200 million senior secured notes issued by Polytama International Finance B.V. and guaranteed by parent PT Polytama Propindo.
It also assigned a B-plus corporate credit rating to Polytama.
The ratings reflect Polytama's aggressive debt usage and growth strategy, and vulnerablility of its feedstock supply and concern for excessive capacity build-up in the region, it said.
However, the negative factors were mitigated by a prospect for continued double-digit growth in the southeast Asian polypropylene market and and the company's advantageous cost position, it said.
Polytama is one of Indonesia's two primary manufacturers of polypropylene with an output of 180,000 tonnes per year, S&P said.
